scope: N=3 MAX; continuous USB read; FULL; configured 200 Hz
condition_basis: User supplied these temperatures to complete the two missing N=3 MAX configurations immediately after the N=2 MAX intake and request to record voltage/current. MAX follows that task context and the new photos outside zero_load. FULL/rate/host state follows the ongoing Power series; DMM photos do not verify actual firmware/rate.
load_definition_note: No mass, area or load distribution was supplied for these two new MAX configurations. Do not copy the older MAX YAMLs' 2000 g value.
readings_source: Fourteen photographs: six DC mA and eight DC V photos, visually transcribed for main, MIN and MAX. All displayed values were readable.
module_mapping_basis: Ascending physical module-ID order established by user. Current and module-voltage photos are mapped independently in filename order.
source_voltage_mapping_basis: Assign first voltage photo in each combination to SOURCE under the established capture convention. Probe endpoint is not visible, so identity is inferred rather than independently verified in the photograph.
temperature_order: Three module STM32 points in ascending module ID, Teensy, regulator
temperature_transcription_note: M0-M1-M3 regulator value supplied as 30 is stored as 30.0 degC for consistent temperature formatting, without inferring extra measurement precision. The trailing backslash is a message line-break artifact.
measurement_meaning: Representative DMM main readings, not verified time averages; MIN/MAX are display extrema, not standard deviations or verified transient peaks. Sequential readings are not simultaneous voltage/current or total-current acquisition.
counting: Two additional MAX configurations with one observation per branch. No independent same-condition repetitions added. Prior N=3 ZERO observations and their user-confirmed MIN values are separate and unchanged.
power_estimate: P_source_output_estimate_mW = V_source_main_V times sequential branch current main sum in mA. Excludes USB-powered Teensy and regulator losses. Source-to-module voltage differences are sequential main-reading differences, not dynamic worst-case drops.
known_limitations: Physical load mass, area and distribution remain unspecified for the new N=2 and N=3 MAX supplements, limiting quantitative comparisons with older MAX observations.
The original two N=3 MAX combinations and the new two were photographed on different dates. Date, setup and combination effects cannot be separated from these single records.
M0-M1-M3 M3 main current is clearly 19.178 mA and is retained even though below other MAX branch currents; no correction or fault inference follows from that difference alone.

Temperatures are point readings without verified ambient reference or settling time. Startup peaks, supply ripple, load-switching waveforms and continuous thermal curves remain future work as requested.

Full configuration coverage does not establish repeatability, uniform load application, zero faults or a validated power-supply capacity. Published main 2.1 and frozen analysis_v2_1 remain unchanged by this data intake.
